clips.title: The story
paras: Nip 'Em in the Bud is a mission directed by Earthseer Farsen to eliminate Dark Iron spies infiltrating Dun Morogh. The clandestine operatives have been spotted lurking near Ironband's Compound, threatening the security of the Bronzebeard homeland.

Dun Morogh has long been a fortified sanctuary for the Ironforge dwarves, but the ancient enmity between the dwarven clans never truly sleeps. Dark Iron infiltrators have slipped through the high passes and snowy crags, skulking suspiciously close to vital excavations and settlements. Earthseer Farsen recognizes that even a few hidden observers can presage a devastating strike, calling on stalwart defenders of the Alliance to root them out before their schemes take hold.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Dark Iron spies have infiltrated Dun Morogh. To what end I canna' be sure, but this is a problem we need to nip in the bud before it is allowed to grow.
Head eastward to Ironband's Compound and kill the Dark Iron spies that you find there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These Dark Irons may be our cousins but they ain't family, that's for sure. I shed no tears for any misfortune that befalls them that stray too far from that accursed mountain o' theirs.
Hopefully this is enough to put 'em off of further incursions into these lands.
